article.title: Filing And Amending Wage Reports
article.body:
How to File a Wage Report

(Manual Entry, Abbreviated ICESA, or 58-Character Text File)

  1. In e-Services go to the Summary tab and click the File a Wage Report link or click the View Wage Reports link followed by the File Now link.
  2. If completing the report manually, enter the SSN, Employer Name, and Wage information into the wage table.  If using an abbreviated ICESA or 58-character text file, upload the file to autocomplete the wage table.
  3. Once complete, review the data on the summary page to ensure all entries are correct. Once verified, confirm your submission by entering a digital signature. The system will then generate a confirmation of submission and process the report immediately.

 

How to Amend a Wage Report

  1. In e-Services, click the View Wage Reports link and select the quarter to amend. 
  2. Click the View or Amend Return link and follow the same steps as filing a wage report (see above). 
  3. Select the reason for amending the wage report.
    • If you are adding wages or an employee that wasn’t on the original report, you will select a reason and give a brief explanation and then you can submit and receive confirmation.
    • If you are decreasing wages or removing an employee, you will select a reason, give a brief explanation, and provide documentation as proof. 
  4. Click Submit.  The system will generate a confirmation of submission.

 

THIRD PARTY ADMINISTRATOR (TPA) or

PROFESSIONAL EMPLOYER ORGANIZATION (PEO)

How to File a Wage Report (Manual Entry)

  1. In e-Services, click the Account Center link.
  2. Click on the individual client’s account and follow the process defined above for Employer Manual Entry.

 

How to Amend a Wage Report

  1. In e-Services, click the Account Center link followed by the individual client’s account.
  2. Follow the process defined above for the Employer.
